title: Axioms for physical reasoning: codifying the Seiberg-Witten solution in Lean
version: arXiv:2607.06379v1, submitted 2026-07-07; companion repository mrdouglasny/seiberg-witten (not inspected in this pass)
locator: HTML v1: Sec. 2 two kinds of formalization; Sec. 4.1 dictionary; Sec. 4.2 H0-H7; Sec. 4.4 what formalizing forces into the open; Sec. 5 checking the axioms; Appendices A-B
relevance: The clearest public discipline for separating named physical postulates from checked mathematics, with a working semantic-audit practice: dependency printing, numerical oracle, adversarial statement review, and vacuity hardening. Direct template for our audit procedure.
limits: Authors' report; repository and oracle scripts not inspected or rerun here. The physical postulates are argued for, not derived; their justification is external review plus numerics by the authors' own account.
design_principles: Physical postulates are named predicates carried in theorem types (H0-H7); the Lean `axiom` keyword carries only mathematics, so physics never hides in the trusted base (Sec. 2, 4.2, Appendix A).

A single dictionary maps each physical concept to a named mathematical object (e.g., PeriodChart.a/.aD/.tau as coupling; SymplecticReframing as duality); physics enters only through the dictionary (Sec. 4.1).
#print axioms reports the complete trusted base of any result; the genus-one uniqueness theorem's reported footprint is three logical axioms plus two classical covering axioms (Sec. 4.3).
Two kinds of formalization distinguished: proving existing rigorous statements vs. codifying trusted non-rigorous arguments (Sec. 2).
failure_modes_documented: Vacuous hypotheses: first-pass H3 ('there exists a lattice map equal to the Picard-Lefschetz transvection') was true by fiat; hardened to demand an actual deck transformation with covariant central charge. H2 hardened to demand a nonzero charge go massless; H5 pinned to 'exactly 2N' was unsatisfiable at rank 1 and corrected to 'order dividing 2N' with the u -> -u reflection as witness (Sec. 4.4).
A convenient falsehood refused by types: single-valued periods would be vacuous (bounded holomorphic map extends and is constant); data must live on the universal cover (Sec. 4.4).

Family-dependence trap: H6's instanton expansion with free coefficients fits any prepotential at fixed Lambda; content appears only as a weighted-homogeneity clause across the Lambda-family (Sec. 4.4). Heuristic recorded: for every existential inside a hypothesis, ask what stops the witness being reverse-engineered.

Adversarial review beat 62 passing numerical checks: a proposed axiom set failed statement-level review with three gaps (pointwise existence without holomorphic choice, missing boundary limits, an unlabelled parabolic slot); a hyperbolic matrix briefly occupied a parabolic slot passing every property the proofs consumed (Sec. 5, 'Validating a transcription').

The checking apparatus itself erred twice (fractional power on the wrong branch; cycle normalization off by a factor of two), caught by anchor values such as lambda(i)=1/2 before agreeing with Lean (Sec. 5, oracle paragraph).
verification_protocol_as_published: Cheapest first: (1) independent numerical oracle in mpmath/numpy sharing no code or authorship with Lean - 9 suites, 278 checks at 30-40 digit precision; authors call a numerical pass 'necessary, not sufficient'; (2) cross-model and self-review against pinned sources, separating 'is it proved?', 'does it say what the source says?', and 'can the intended theorems be derived from it?'; (3) transcription validation with four checks - instantiation, oracle, agreement with independently proved results, adversarial content; (4) the physicist's triangle: independent routes to the same quantity (perturbation theory, Nekrasov instantons, exact periods) attached as a cross-check rather than asserted (Sec. 5).
authors_claim: AI's characteristic error in physics derivations is 'a hallucinated assumption, an unphysical premise or a dropped subtlety presented as if derived' (Sec. 1) - the error class our audit targets.
proof_status: Authors report sorry-free genus-one theorems with printed axiom footprints; not rebuilt here.
open_questions: Inspect mrdouglasny/seiberg-witten: pin commit, read validate_singcount.py and oracle suites, verify the printed axiom footprints by building.
